summary: XCF Global, Inc. filed an 8-K/A reporting a payable settlement agreement with Encore DEC, LLC, converting ~$16.7M in accounts payable into 37,033,386 shares of Class A Common Stock at $0.451/share. Encore, 100% owned by major shareholder Randy Soule, provides EPC services. Post-conversion, Soule will own 30.56% of outstanding Class A shares. The transaction increases equity capitalization and reduces debt. No board recommendation or advisor is named. While reducing leverage, the share issuance dilutes existing holders. The close is effective May 6, 2026. Watch for dilution impact and potential selling pressure; risk-arb angle is limited as this is a debt-for-equity swap, not a tender or acquisition.
